purpose: Teach: ときには/何一つ/御飯/もうけ/たずね/そうこう/おみやげ/壊れる

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、ときには売上が落ち込む日もあるよね、メイちゃん
lines.en: You know, Aoi, even on good days there are moments when things slow down a little.
lines.style: Gentle, knowing tone. Soft opening. Speaking from experience, not lecturing. A quiet acknowledgment shared between equals. Warm pause before the name.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様に何一つ不満を与えないお店にしたいね、メイちゃん
lines.en: I want to make sure our customers never feel disappointed when they come here.
lines.style: Earnest and clear. Leans forward slightly on the intention. Steady conviction without being preachy. The warmth of someone thinking about others genuinely.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、御飯セットも始めようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: So let's start offering meal sets too—give people more reasons to stay.
lines.style: Practical, almost conversational. A suggestion framed as collaboration. Light touch of excitement underneath. Matter-of-fact in delivery.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、薄利だけど、お店もうけが出てきたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: You were right—even with thin margins, we're actually starting to see real profit.
lines.style: Brightening slightly. Pleasant surprise held in check. A small vindication delivered without smugness. Warm acknowledgment of Aoi's instinct.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、たずねてくる方が増えてきたね、メイちゃん
lines.en: And the customers—more and more people are coming in asking about us.
lines.style: Reflective wonder. Pace slows slightly, like she's still getting used to the fact. Genuine surprise underneath. Noticing something that matters.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、そうこうしているうちに閉店時間になっちゃったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Before we knew it, we were already closing up for the night.
lines.style: Wry, a little bemused. The delivery of someone who just realized time flew. Slight lift at the end—not quite a laugh, but the recognition of it. Affectionate.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様への小さなおみやげ、用意しようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Let's prepare a little gift for the customers—something for them to take home.
lines.style: Tender and quiet. The care showing through in the specificity. Speaking as though this matters—because it does. Slow, deliberate, gentle.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お皿が壊れるのが心配で慎重に運ぶよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I'll carry the plates carefully—I'm worried about breaking anything.
lines.style: Attentive and cautious. Focused on the task with quiet concentration. The kind of carefulness that comes from caring. Steady hands, steady voice.
